ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point C is a point on the line segment $AB$, point M is the midpoint of line segment $AC$, and point N is the midpoint of line segment $BC$. Given that $AB=20$, what is the length of $MN$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $M$ be the midpoint of segment $AC$, and $N$ be the midpoint of segment $BC$,\\
$\therefore$ $MC=\frac{1}{2}AC$, $NC=\frac{1}{2}BC$,\\
$\therefore$ $MN=MC+NC=\frac{1}{2}\left(AC+BC\right)=\frac{1}{2}AB$,\\
Given that $AB=20$,\\
$\therefore$ $MN=\frac{1}{2}\times 20=\boxed{10}$.
